milestone: Exact CPU String equality and checked concatenation

implementation.source: String +, == and != through typed helpers, imports, conditionals, short-circuit logic and synchronous map callbacks
implementation.IR: Dedicated StringConcat with validated operand/result identity; ScalarCompare accepts String equality only; explicit checked runtime calls in MLIR/LLVM
implementation.ownership: Flat UTF-8 concatenation validates both operands, checks the int64 combined count, then allocates/copies new invocation-owned storage; empty/empty canonicalizes without allocation; outputs publish only on completion
implementation.equality: Full descriptor/UTF-8 validation precedes length/prefix shortcuts; exact length-delimited bytes without normalization or NUL termination; equality itself allocates nothing
implementation.cancellation: Bounded polling in input validation, comparison and copying; failed/cancelled outputs stay empty and partial owners settle
implementation.limits: Lengths/indexing/slicing, String fields/arrays, String captures, workers and placement remain gated. Borrowed task diagnostic equality reaches the explicit ordinary-String gate.

coverage: Exact UTF-8/NUL/BOM/emoji/combining-mark sequences and empty/prefix cases
All equality/concatenation design vectors; no normalization or implicit numeric/Bool conversions
Imported/chained helper results, precedence, short circuit and selected fault path; synchronous Bool map callbacks
Unknown/settled owners, base mismatch, negative/oversized counts and invalid trailing bytes rejected before length/prefix/alias shortcuts
Combined-count domain boundary tests; immutable operands, aliased descriptor output, allocation failure and retained result lifetime
Asynchronous cancellation after operand validation during large equality/concat operations; no partial output or owner leaks
Unsupported ordering/mixed operands, String task diagnostic equality and forged concat/comparison IR rejected
Fresh core frontend, numerical Bool comparison/worker, task recovery, file-module and record-array-map regressions
qualification.scope: Focused CPU qualification; no GPU/distributed String claim. Optimized uses optimized generated programs/harnesses with the existing core runtime archive, as in the foundation suite.
qualification.build_notes: String/runtime test binaries were freshly relinked against the extended runtime before regression checks. No production source changes after the successful String run.

native/lib/CheckedABI.cpp.change: Add checked String concat/equal runtime calls; preserve existing numeric rules
